# DJ PRO JAY

> Portfolio of Irakoze Icyubahiro Jean Pierre (DJ PRO JAY): a Rwandan DJ, music producer and software developer. The site has two realms, one for DJ work and one for software development.

## Pages

- [Portal](https://djprojay.vercel.app/): landing page to choose a realm
- [DJ realm](https://djprojay.vercel.app/dj): mixes, sets, skills, FAQ and booking contact
- [Dev realm](https://djprojay.vercel.app/dev): software projects, skills, FAQ and contact

- [Sitemap](https://djprojay.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
